item.text: [{"task_id":"d255d7a7","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    black = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    background = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    size = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    step = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    if step <= 0 or size != step + step + step:","        return grid.copy()","    for value in params['rotations']:","        turns = int(round(value))","        g = np.rot90(grid, turns)","        height, width = g.shape","        if width <= size or height < size:","            continue","        starts = []","        for row in range(height - size + step):","            if np.all(g[row, :size] == black) and np.all(g[row + size - step, :size] == black) and np.all(g[row + step, size - step:] == black):","                starts.append(row)","        if starts:","            out = g.copy()","            out[g == black] = background","            for row in starts:","                out[row:row + size, :size] = background","            for row in starts:","                out[row:row + size, width - size:] = g[row:row + size, :size]","            return np.rot90(out, -turns)","    return grid.copy()"],"shapes":{"colors":[2],"geometry":[2],"rotations":[4]},"params":{"colors":[0,7],"geometry":[3,1],"rotations":[0,1,2,3]},"rationale":"Rotate to identify each edge-mounted black U with a straight stem reaching the opposite edge. Erase the stems and move each intact 3×3 U to that opposite edge, preserving enclosed red cells and leaving external red cells in place."}]
